newsitem.title: MEXICO: FORECAST-Mexico 28-day Cetes seen rising 46 bp.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Mexico 28-day Cetes seen rising 46 bp.

text.p: Interest rates on Mexico's bellwether 28-day Cetes, or T-bills, are seen rising 46 basis points to 20.50 percent at Tuesday's Banco de Mexico auction, and rates are also seen rising at most of the longer terms, a Reuters' survey of nine Cetes dealers showed.
Following is a table comparing last week's primary rates versus expectations for this week's auction and the expected change in basis points.
